title: Native Select
api:
interface NativeSelectOption {
  value: string
  label: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

type NativeSelectProps = Omit<
  SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement>,
  'size' | 'multiple'
> & {
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  loading?: boolean
  previewState?: UIState
  items?: NativeSelectOption[]
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void
}
